column3: The commandments are stored with you rather than explicitly within you.
The ear is made attentive; a repeated if is not explicit.
The shield is named without a separate He is.
Knowledge will be pleasant to your soul rather than actively delighting it.
The people are devious in their tracks rather than the ways being the subject.
The Hebrew calls the woman foreign rather than forbidden and explicitly describes making her words smooth.
The house's sinking is expressed as completed.
The Hebrew says attain or reach the paths rather than negotiate them.
The way of good people is singular.
The second verb is passive, will be left in it.
